title: Room-Temperature Oxidation of Thulium-Metal Nanoparticles to the Thulium Oxocluster [Tm5O(OiPr)13]

material_class.structural_family: pentanuclear Ln5O(OiPr)13 oxocluster with square-pyramidal Tm5O core

synthesis.procedure: Washed and dried Tm(0) nanoparticles (prepared separately by one-pot reduction of TmCl3 with Li/naphthalene in THF, then washed with toluene/THF and dried in vacuum) and isopropanol were placed in a glass ampoule, sealed under inert conditions, and stored for seven days at room temperature. Colorless thin crystals of [Tm5O(OiPr)13] formed; the reaction is described as quantitative because no black Tm(0) nanoparticles remained.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed glass ampoule under inert conditions
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: colorless thin single crystals formed in the ampoule after seven days; no remaining black Tm(0) nanoparticles

properties.summary: Variable-temperature dc susceptibility (2–300 K) shows χT = 24 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature, below the 35.7 cm3 K mol−1 expected for five uncoupled Tm3+ ions (ascribed in part to adhered solvent). χT decreases slowly on cooling then more rapidly below 25 K to 6 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with thermal depopulation of mJ sublevels plus antiferromagnetic Tm3+–Tm3+ coupling. AC susceptibility showed no out-of-phase χ″ signal, so no SMM behavior was observed.

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; polycrystalline sample in eicosane; MPMS-XL SQUID; 2–300 K dc susceptibility

source_locations.location: magnetism paragraph and Figure 6; Experimental Magnetism
